content: cloudflared config.yml (locally-managed tunnel) requires tunnel name, credentials-file path, and ingress rules list; every ingress block must end with a catch-all with no hostname (typically service: http_status:404) or cloudflared refuses to start. 'cloudflared service install' registers a systemd unit (cloudflared.service) for boot-time start and auto-restart. As of 2025.4.0+, remotely-managed (dashboard/token-based) tunnels are simpler: create tunnel in Zero Trust dashboard, run the one-line install command with --token, no config.yml or cert.pem needed; routing edited in the dashboard without local restarts.
